notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2099670/Pirates_Journey/


The island's secrets continue to be unraveled with each update of Pirates Journey. The location of the gold that pirates hid as a result of plunder was revealed: Buccaneers Hideout

Update Pirates Journey now and discover this brand new dangerous Buccaneers Hideout!

notes.title: Co-Op Hotfix 1.43
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2099670/Pirates_Journey/


[h2]Ahoy Mates![/h2]

A large-scale "Marine Update" is being prepared for Pirates Journey.


Before this, we fixed critical errors encountered in the [b]Co-Op game[/b].


* The bug of the Client not having Inventory at the start of the game in Co-Op games has been fixed.

* The mouse cursor appearing on the Client's screen at the start of the game in Co-Op games has been fixed.

* Fixed the error that occurred when Conner clicked on The Potato Farmer's book in the Co-Op game.

* Co-Op gameplay has been made much smoother. You can also try the Co-Op game and see.

notes.title: Lowering the price of the game for the Polish currency, the złoty
notes.content:
After a conversation with a Polish person and familiarizing ourself with the situation, We've decided to appropriately lower the price of our game in Polish złoty. We support your initiative and wish all the best to the Polish people. 

Greetings from 2Medya Game Studio.

PS: The price will be reduced to 31.99 PLN as soon as Steam accepts the changes.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.42
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2099670/Pirates_Journey/

[h3]Ahoy Mates![/h3]

There will be a few hotfixes coming before the next big update. One of them is Hotfix 1.42

* We received notifications from some players that they could not collect the flags of enemy bases when they raided them.

With this update, you can collect flags when you raid enemy pirate bases. Each Enemy base has its own flagpole. The collection option will appear in front of the flagpoles.

* Enemy raids on our pirate camp at regular intervals have been improved.
Instead of raids from a single area, you can now raid from any entrance to your pirate camp.
The Raiders are more diverse now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43430024/8a28aa82b10bd7281da8481ddf909aa5f540606e.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43430024/5c002cf8d37c6f67b8c3151e463482acceba1989.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Know your Crew!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2099670/Pirates_Journey/


Every pirate captain knows his crew very well. He knows them by name.

You will now be able to recognize your crew members who undertake duties such as Carpenter, Farmer, Blacksmith in your pirate camp by their names. You can try it now with this update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43430024/fcc4071d76d2b38b591c673ef316c41fa13d7013.png[/img]

[h3]Road Map for Pirates Journey Crew System:[/h3]
In the next update, you will be able to assign separate tasks to each of your crew.

Among these tasks, arming them, establishing a pirate gang and conducting raids are on our development road map.

notes.title: Pirates Journey New Achievements
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

It has been now a little bit over 10 days since we started our Early Access Journey and we couldn't be happier about your reception of our game. If you want to be an even more active part of the development process, feel free to join us on our [url=https://discord.gg/BMZAb4Bf9u]Pirates Journey Discord Server[/url]

In Pirates Journey, a "resource management" system will be added to the game so you can better manage your colony. This includes new buildings and managing your crew. We will go into more detail about building a [b]Pirate Colony[/b].

We fixed more than 50 minor bugs with this patch. And we've revamped the [b]Pirates Journey Steam Achievements[/b]. A total of 23 new Achievements have been added to the game.

Please feel free to share your experiences with our new Steam Achievements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43430024/495b5571d70de884432045ad26398a4d5628ba8c.png[/img]

notes.title: Build your Pirate Colony
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43430024/24968175c6cebd97761036a361c3eb32d528f30a.jpg[/img]

Build your pirate colony with carpenters, blacksmiths and many more buildings. Don't forget to build fields to feed your crew.

You can play Pirates Journey Full version in Single Player and Co-Op Multiplayer. By playing Co-Op, you can build your Pirate Camp together and raid opposing bases managed by AI factions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43430024/0004acb65e4b9597b551805ecf09adb5e92ec142.jpg[/img]

[b]Other features of Pirates Journey:[/b]

Set Up Your Camp and Expand: Gather resources on islands and seas. Build new Buildings. Grow your pirate camp by building buildings like Carpenter, Blacksmith etc.

Survive with your crew: As the captain, you must survive first. Build new fields for your crews. Organize and train your crews. Give them tasks.

Raid enemy factions and capture their bases: You are not alone on the islands. Raid the bases of enemy pirate captains. In addition to you, 3 different pirate captains fight among themselves for a total of more than 50 different bases and outposts.

Solve the mysteries of the island and the surrounding seas: You will learn the stories of 7 pirate captains mentioned in the legends. Dig graves, follow the maps and explore the surroundings to find the treasure they hide.

[previewyoutube=auQZQqW6cKs;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Get ready to play Pirates Journey Multiplayer
notes.content:
Grab your swords! Prepare to conquer the main island and surrounding seas with your friends.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43430024/923904f44cfe07ece2b5f742fd3ffcd54ffe40b5.jpg[/img]

Some things you can do in Pirates Journey Multiplayer game:

* Build your Pirate colony in Co-Op. Farm with your crew and build new buildings.

* Raid the bases of 3 enemy AI captains on the map in Co-Op.

* Explore Pirates Journey's massive map in Co-Op. Solve the mystery of the lost treasure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43430024/0af9aefff0ca90529e3d716aa4844be2dc47bab9.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Know The Enemy Factions
notes.content:
[b]Who are the Factions?[/b]

You are not alone in Pirates Journey. Apart from you, there are 3 more enemy factions played by the AI on the main island and the surrounding seas.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43430024/4249871731a3d91e59ce3d2ca615f02347c8dcf5.png[/img]

[i]You can see the number of enemy factions, bases and crew on your map, which you open with the "M" key.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43430024/faeaddf18ee76c0b3e961129410d3cf47f4029a8.png[/img]

[b]Faction Outposts[/b]

Enemy factions have settlements just like you. They house a certain amount of soldiers in these outposts.

You can raid enemy Outposts alone or with your friends when playing Co-Op.

When you kill all enemy soldiers in an enemy outpost, you capture it.

[b]Raids on your camp by factions[/b]

Enemy factions may raid your main camp at regular intervals.

notes.title: Explore The Pirates Journey's Map !
notes.content:
Crocodile Beach, Dangerous Forest, Mysterious Old Mine, Buccaneer's Den…

These are some of the places you can explore in Pirates Journey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43430024/2debda7954ea475fb3efe56e9ea2c8b43cad452f.png[/img]

You can open your map (with the M key) and start exploring immediately.

(In Pirates Journey Demo Version, the areas that can be visited on the map are limited)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43430024/d9884e9937eda23ab28ca2d77163eecf46e0b0ee.png[/img]

notes.title: Get ready to sail the relentless seas
notes.content:
The island you shipwrecked on in Pirates Journey was just the beginning.

In the next Pirates Journey Demo/Beta update, you will be able to explore the surrounding seas and islands by building your Boat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43430024/4261332ccd1b9ea481eea6d6e9e75f3019db6d5c.jpg[/img]

Yes, enemy factions also have bases on the surrounding islands. You will be able to raid and capture them.

There are islands with more than 50 bases in the open sea. All factions are fighting to have the most candidates.

According to the Pirate Code, only the strong survive!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43430024/4edfd4484575e419227f8e00977696f834d2b5d1.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Pirates Incoming: It's time to Raid
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43430024/89a15cb8860b5a81de001a7d5cea1d13b3398fe4.jpg[/img]

We would like to inform you about a new phase in the development of Pirates Journey: Base Raids.

It's time to explore the bases of enemy factions in Pirates Journey, raid them and become the ultimate ruler of the island!

If you do not capture their bases, there is no doubt that they will attack you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43430024/d100c16c0179c8bd74f4f506b0d82a3b0069a483.jpg[/img]

There are brand new firearms you can craft. And of course, the brutal pirates who attack you with these weapons.

May the best captain and his crew win!

* You can enjoy base raids as singleplayer with the Pirates Journey Beta 0.57 update.

* Yes, we know, you don't have a map. For now, you can explore the island by traveling. Soon, you may even be able to go beyond the sea with an interactive map. Who knows.

* For co-op play, we are preparing additional great innovations for base raids. Developments continue to ensure that the co-op experience allows you to establish tactics and offers a never-ending game.

* When the time comes, we would like to invite you to our Co-op Beta tests to hear your valuable feedback.

We would like to thank our friends who made videos for previous versions. We are excitedly waiting for the videos to be released for this brand new Base Raids (0.57) update.

* All our friends who helped with the beta process, please update Pirates Journey to the latest version, 0.57, and start the game from the beginning.

notes.title: Pirates Journey, Sharpen your swords and prepare your gunpowder
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43430024/c1eef504ad85d492473a39097bc8c4acc8524d02.jpg[/img]

Ahoy Pirates! Are you ready to immerse yourself to survive on a tropical island and a world full of deep sea dangers? Get ready to live the life of a real pirate in our exciting survival game!

In Pirates Journey you will have to fight for your life as you try to survive on the dangerous island and face rival pirates and other dangers. But don't worry, you won't be alone in your adventure. You will be able to assemble a team of brave pirates to accompany you on your quest and help you face any obstacle that comes your way. You can manage your crew, develop your own pirate town and become the ruler of the island.

With its stunning graphics and addictive gameplay, Pirates Journey comes for those who love pirate and survival games.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43430024/eb52fc25f3e30423442161d24fa37f89bde6c226.jpg[/img]
